== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|Duster is an alias used by [[Dalton Foster]], a man over seventy years old with unkempt gray hair, a thick beard, and two sets of spectacles. Though he frequently forgets his assumed name, he is a skilled former gunsmith capable of assembling pistols or crafting reliable muskets. He carries a wide leather utility belt filled with various small tools. While he identifies as a Reader, he notes that he lacks the ability to cast significant fireballs. He has previously lived in the Capital and was traveling through [[Silverreach]] at the time of his introduction.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|Duster is a Reader who possesses the power to use fire. Additionally, he serves as the [[Vessel]] of a [[Soulbound]] craftsman.}}
